blocks.label: Text: You appear to be in a season when pieces are beginning to come together.…
blocks.value: You appear to be in a season when pieces are beginning to come together. You may have questioned, searched, and released beliefs that no longer felt honest. Now you are looking for a center you can actually live from.

Heading: A Spiral, Not a Ladder
Text: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, …
blocks.value: Spiritual growth is rarely linear. We receive, question, seek, rebuild, embody, and awaken - often more than once. No stage is a rank, and no stage makes anyone more loved by God.

blocks.label: Text: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's…
blocks.value: The stages describe how our relationship to faith may change - not God's relationship to us. Jesus remains at the center of the journey.

blocks.label: Heading: A truer center is beginning to emerge.
blocks.value: A truer center is beginning to emerge.

blocks.label: Text: You may feel drawn again to Jesus, Scripture, prayer, and community - bu…
blocks.value: You may feel drawn again to Jesus, Scripture, prayer, and community - but differently. You are less interested in defending a system and more interested in discovering what is trustworthy, life-giving, and real.

blocks.label: Text: One common risk is replacing the old certainty with a new certainty, or …
blocks.value: One common risk is replacing the old certainty with a new certainty, or making reconstruction entirely intellectual. A living foundation is more than an updated set of beliefs. It is a center practiced in relationship, tested by its fruit, and held with humility.

blocks.label: Heading: You are allowed to build slowly.
blocks.value: You are allowed to build slowly.

blocks.label: Text: A durable faith does not need to answer every question at once.
blocks.value: A durable faith does not need to answer every question at once.

blocks.label: Text: You can return to his words and way without preserving every interpretat…
blocks.value: You can return to his words and way without preserving every interpretation you inherited.

blocks.label: Heading: A foundation is known by its fruit.
blocks.value: A foundation is known by its fruit.

blocks.label: Text: Look for love, freedom, compassion, courage, and humility.
blocks.value: Look for love, freedom, compassion, courage, and humility.

blocks.label: Text: Scripture, prayer, community, and embodied choices create a place to sta…
blocks.value: Scripture, prayer, community, and embodied choices create a place to stand.

Text: Lectio Divina - letting Scripture become encounter.
blocks.value: Lectio Divina - letting Scripture become encounter.

blocks.label: Text: Become still. Read Matthew 7:24-27 in a translation you trust.
blocks.value: Become still. Read Matthew 7:24-27 in a translation you trust.

blocks.label: Text: Read slowly, twice. Notice one word or phrase that catches your attentio…
blocks.value: Read slowly, twice. Notice one word or phrase that catches your attention.

blocks.label: Text: Let the phrase meet your actual life without rushing to explain or prove…
blocks.value: Let the phrase meet your actual life without rushing to explain or prove it.

blocks.label: Text: Speak honestly with God, sit in silence, and choose one small way to pra…
blocks.value: Speak honestly with God, sit in silence, and choose one small way to practice what you heard.

blocks.label: Text: Try the same passage for seven days. Notice how its invitation changes a…
blocks.value: Try the same passage for seven days. Notice how its invitation changes as you practice it.

blocks.label: Text: Open the online Inspired Reading practice and move through the passage s…
blocks.value: Open the online Inspired Reading practice and move through the passage step by step.
